title: West China Cement shares fall 40% year-on-year
summary: West China Cement shares fall 40% year-on-year
body_markdown: **China:** West China Cement reported a 40% year-on-year decrease in its share price from US$347,567 in 2025 to US$208,994 on 9 November 2026. This downturn reflects systematic reductions in China’s domestic construction sector.
